title: Conservative left exact functors reflect finite limits
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories, let $\mathcal C$ have finite limits ([def-galois-finite-limits-colimits]), and let $V\colon\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ preserve finite limits. Suppose $V$ reflects isomorphisms: a morphism $f$ of $\mathcal C$ is invertible whenever $Vf$ is invertible. Then $V$ reflects finite limits: for every finite category $J$, diagram $K\colon J\to\mathcal C$ and cone $c$ on $K$, if the image cone $Vc$ is a limit cone of $V\circ K$, then $c$ is a limit cone of $K$. Here preservation of finite limits means that the image of every finite limit cone is a limit cone.
